name: Terraria (tModLoader)
description: Modded Terraria with tModLoader. Add mods from the Steam Workshop in one click; worlds are saved cleanly on stop.

variables.label: tModLoader version
variables.description: latest, or a release tag such as v2026.08.3.0. Players need the same version; Steam keeps theirs on the latest one.

variables.label: World name
variables.description: Letters, digits, - and _. Created on first start if it does not exist.

variables.label: World size
variables.description: Only used when the world is first created.

variables.label: Difficulty
variables.description: Only used when the world is first created.

variables.label: World seed
variables.description: Leave blank for a random world. Only used when the world is first created.

notes:
Runs [tModLoader](https://github.com/tModLoader/tModLoader) on the [DeployKit tModLoader image](https://github.com/deploykithq/deploykit-game-images/tree/master/images/tmodloader), which downloads the release from GitHub on the first start.

- Add mods from the **Mods** tab: paste a Steam Workshop link, or search once an admin adds a Steam Web API key in Settings. Workshop items download their latest upload when the server restarts.
- A `.tmod` uploaded by hand to `tModLoader/Mods` stays enabled.
- Players need the same mods; tModLoader offers to download them when they join.
- Disabling a mod a world depends on can break that world, so DeployKit takes a safety backup first.
- World name, size, difficulty and seed only apply when the world is created.
- Stopping the server sends `exit`, which saves the world first.
